emily: Quick sync 10: pricing A/B rollout next Wed. Need final sign-offs on grandfathering window + invoice reconciliation steps. Can we capture decisions here? :calendar:

raj: I can validate migrations scripts and run a dry-run of invoice adjustments. Question: are we doing a 14-day grandfather window or per-contract end-of-term?

zoe: Legal prefers per-contract term where feasible, but ops warned that creates many edge PRs. Proposal: default 14-day soft grandfather for usage charges, hold subscription-level committed rates until contract expiration.

cfo-sig: Preference is minimal customer impact. 14-day soft grandfather is acceptable if it prevents billing spikes. Need an estimated risk bucket for potential refunds.

emily: Good. Action items: 1) implement 14-day soft grandfather for usage tokens, 2) keep committed subscription rates until contract end, 3) flag enterprise/reseller for manual review.

raj: I'll add a safeguard in the migration SQL to set `price_apply_date = GREATEST(customer.next_invoice_date, migration_ts)` when contract_locked = true. Pasting draft snippet:

```sql
UPDATE billing_events
SET applied_price = $new_price,
    applied_price_version = 'v2-ab-2026-03',
    applied_at = migration_ts
WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT id FROM ab_group_a)
  AND contract_locked = false
  AND event_date >= migration_ts;
```

zoe: Looks good. Add a `manual_review` tag for any customer where contract_locked = true and projected delta > $500. That helps CS prioritize outreach.

billing-bot: Preview: 8 invoices with projected delta > $500 for cohort A. Preview token: pvw_20260308_7.

emily: For reconciliation, finance wants: invoice_id, customer_id, contract_line_id, old_unit_price, new_unit_price, projected_delta_usd, applied_price_version. Raj can you produce CSV?

raj: Yes. Will include billing_region and promo_override columns too. Will deliver CSV by Monday AM.

zoe: Ops: schedule a low-risk canary (0.5%) for first 24h, then 5% for next 48h if delta thresholds < 2% of revenue. Also we need an automated rollback trigger based on refund rate > 0.2% or delta_median > $100.

emily: Agree on metrics. Zoe, please create Grafana and PagerDuty playbook links in this thread when ready.

zoe: Will do. Also adding a runbook step: disable `pricing_v2_ab` flag via feature-ops and verify flag propagation to dedicated and private runtime.

billing-bot: Scheduled job: invoice preview expiry in 48h for pvw_20260308_7.

cfo-sig: Approving the plan contingent on finance review of projected_delta report and an executive readout after 48h. Please tag me when CSV is posted.

emily: Noted. Final checklist I'm tracking here:
- [ ] CSV with projected deltas (raj)
- [ ] Canary pipeline and Grafana (zoe)
- [ ] Legal list of per-contract exceptions (zoe)
- [ ] Billing export includes `applied_price_version` (raj)
- [ ] Feature flag gating + rollback playbook (zoe)
- [ ] Exec notification after 48h (emily)

raj: CSV created: s3://redwood-billing/previews/pvw_20260308_7.csv (will attach to the ticket).

emily: Thanks. I'm locking the change window to Tue 06:00-10:00 UTC to minimize overlap with EMEA billing runs. Any objections?

cfo-sig: Ok with that window.

zoe: No objections. I'll schedule the canary in that slot.

emily: Great. Tagging this thread as the single source of truth for cutover decisions. Please keep updates concise. :white_check_mark:
